wins.text: Net income of $13.4B, EPS of $4.44 on revenue of $42.5B with ROTCE of 21% for Q1-2024
Firm-wide IB fees up 21% YoY; debt underwriting up 58% and equity underwriting up 51% YoY; ranked #1 with YTD wallet share of 9.1%
AWM AUM of $3.6T up 19% YoY and client assets of $5.2T up 20% YoY, with long-term net inflows of $34B in the quarter
First Republic contributed $1.7B revenue and $668M net income in Q1, annualizing above the $2B full-year figure cited in the CEO letter
CET1 ratio of 15% with $2B/quarter buyback ongoing; dividend raised mid-cycle reflecting excess capital generation

risks.text: FDIC special assessment increased by $725M due to updated loss estimates from SVB and Signature Bank closures, driving expenses to $22B, up 9% YoY
Card net charge-offs up $825M YoY on continued normalization; reserve build expected in back half of 2024 as card loan growth of ~12% full-year continues
NII ex Markets guidance of ~$89B implies sequential NII compression as deposit margin normalization continues; deposit migration from checking/savings to CDs ongoing with no sign of slowing
CIB cautioned that strong Q1 capital markets activity likely pulled forward from later in the year, particularly in DCM where a high percentage of full-year refinancing needs were completed in Q1
Jamie Dimon flagged elevated macro, geopolitical, and regulatory uncertainty including stagflation risk, higher-for-longer rates, and potential CRE stress beyond office if rates rise further

guidance_items.detail: Total NII guidance maintained at ~$90B; NII ex Markets now ~$89B (slightly refined from prior)
Markets NII guidance reduced from ~$2B to ~$1B due to balance sheet mix shift in financing businesses; described as revenue-neutral
Adjusted expense outlook raised to ~$91B from prior guidance, reflecting $725M FDIC special assessment increase
2024 Card net charge-off rate expected to remain below 3.5%
Effective tax rate expected to remain ~23% for 2024, absent discrete items; no meaningful impact on annual net income

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Basel III endgame capital deployment timeline and the 17% through-the-cycle CET1 target implications
Private credit competitive dynamics and JPM's strategic positioning relative to private credit providers
Potential future FDIC-assisted bank acquisition opportunities and competition from private equity/family offices
